nodes.summary: Given labels $\mathrm{hit}(i)$ and $\mathrm{miss}(i)$ for the codes $i < g$, the read test for code $i$ is the statement, on a counter machine's stacks plus an input stack of codes, that peeks at the top of the input stack and sets the flag to whether it equals $i$. If it does, the test pops it and goes to $\mathrm{hit}(i)$; otherwise (including when the input stack is empty) it goes to $\mathrm{miss}(i)$.
nodes.title: Read test for one code

nodes.summary: For $g, n \in \mathbb{N}$, the generator label that tests for input code $0$ when $g > 0$, and the error label when $g = 0$.
nodes.title: The first read test

nodes.summary: Let $M'$ be a machine on a counter machine's stacks plus an input stack of codes $< g$, with labels $\mathrm{rd}(i)$, $\mathrm{hit}(i)$ and $\mathrm{miss}(i)$ for $i < g$, such that at $\mathrm{rd}(i)$ it runs the read test for code $i$ with these hit and miss labels, and $\mathrm{miss}(i) = \mathrm{rd}(i + 1)$ whenever $i + 1 < g$. Then for all counter stacks $S$, codes $c$, input lists $xs$, all $k$ and codes $i$…
nodes.title: The read chain

nodes.summary: An assignment $F$ of natural numbers to the generator's counters has empty scratch counters when $F(Q) = F(\mathrm{tmp}) = F(\mathrm{md}) = F(c_1) = F(c_2) = 0$.
nodes.title: Empty scratch counters

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a counter machine (unit counters indexed by $C$ and a Boolean output stack) and $M'$ a machine on the same stacks plus an input stack over $G$, such that $M'$ embeds $M$ along the inclusion of the counter stacks with the same labels (at every label whose statement is not the halt statement, $M'$ runs $M$'s statement). If $M$ runs in $n$ steps from optional label $l$, flag $v$ and stacks $S$ to a label…
nodes.title: Run lifting

nodes.summary: For a clause kind $c$ of the init-family generator and a literal index $l \in \mathbb{N}$, the sign of literal $l$ of $c$ is positive in every case except one: for the prefix-form phase (clause group I5), literal $0$ is negative and every literal $l \ne 0$ is positive.
nodes.title: Literal signs of an init-family clause kind

nodes.summary: Fix natural numbers $i_c$ and $g'$ and a list $Y$ of natural numbers, which determine the offsets of the literals of each clause kind from the base. A clause kind $c$ is well formed when these offsets are strictly increasing: for every $l \in \mathbb{N}$ with $l + 1$ less than the number of literals of $c$, the offset of literal $l$ of $c$ is less than the offset of literal $l + 1$ of $c$.
nodes.title: Well-formed init-family clause kinds

nodes.summary: Given an encoding $E$ of a machine $M$ and a list $Y$ of symbols of the input stack of $M$, this is the list of the distinct codes that $E$ assigns to the symbols of $Y$ on the input stack, sorted in strictly increasing order.
nodes.title: Sorted certificate code list

nodes.summary: For a variable layout $L$, a stack number $k_0$, a number $H$ of tracked depths per stack and a depth $j$, this is the index of the cell variable of $L$ at time $0$ for stack $k_0$, depth $j$ and symbol code $0$ (the empty cell $\bot$), namely $A + (k_0 H + j)\,g$, where $A$ is the size of the label/state block of $L$ and $g$ is its number of symbol codes.
nodes.title: Empty-cell variable of the initial row

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
